_comment: HPSDR Protocol 1 example (Web-888, Red Pitaya): one SparkGap for all of a radio's receivers, one band per receiver, the radio's one stream. SparkGap Web's Add a receiver writes it from this file (docs/WEB888_GETTING_STARTED.md); by hand, copy to <radio>.local.json and set callsign, grid and sdr_ip. Every HPSDR radio on one computer needs its own hpsdr_listen_port and telnet_port. telnet stays on localhost until you mean to feed a cluster.
_comment_cw_decoder: itila2 is the default chain: the itila2 decoder and scanner together, with the repeat spot rule (hotairfred/SparkGap#18, with itila_decode_threads); cw_decoder itila selects the original one. See docs/ITILA2.md.
_comment_spot_validation: A confidence score decides which calls spot (docs/ITILA2.md); rbn+skcc adds calls known from the RBN archives and the SKCC roster, cached in rbn_known_dir. Measured on the 24-hour dry run, cdub89/SparkGap#10.
_comment_gui_feed: SparkGap Web (docs/SERVER_SETUP.md). On loopback only, with no join code; set bind and join_code to reach it from another machine.
